data.case_title: Rejection of beach bonfire permit application
data.title: Ordnungsamt rejects permit for New Year's beach bonfire
data.summary: The Ordnungsamt of Amt Musterschlei (signed by Carstensen) rejects Mr. Beispielholm's application for a traditional New Year's bonfire on the beach near Knickweg, because the site lies in the "Musterschlei-Ufer" landscape protection area and would disturb breeding birds in the adjacent reed bed. The letter was issued on 18 November 2026 and includes an objection (Widerspruch) notice.
data.explanation: The authority has refused permission for your planned bonfire on the protected beach strip, suggesting you join the municipality's communal fire at the harbour square instead. If you disagree with this decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at the office; the app will show the deadline for this, which is counted from when the letter is considered delivered. If you take no action, the rejection becomes final and you may not hold the fire at that location.

items.title: File an objection (Widerspruch) against the bonfire permit rejection
items.action: Decide whether to object in writing or in person at the Ordnungsamt against the refusal of your bonfire permit, by the deadline shown.

key_facts.label: Reason for rejection
key_facts.value: Location in the landscape protection area "Musterschlei-Ufer" with nearby bird breeding grounds
key_facts.quote: Der Abschnitt liegt im Landschaftsschutzgebiet „Musterschlei-Ufer“, und die Brutplätze im angrenzenden Röhricht dürfen nicht gestört werden.
